note: Both sets share the same five chordwise-center claims from Figure 2-11, so the difference is Set A's two axial-stiffness claims. Set A reads the y-axis tick '0' as a value at r/R = 0.0 and the axis multiplier '1e10' as a value at r/R = 1.0; the plotted curve actually starts near 4.5e10 N at the root and ends near 0.2e10 N at the tip. Set B omits axial stiffness entirely but adds nothing wrong, so it is the more faithful set.
remarks: Set A's two axial-stiffness claims are axis-label artifacts: '0' is a y-axis tick and '1e10' is the scale multiplier, not data points; the quotes are assembled from axis text and do not support the claimed values. Both sets leave out the mass-density, edgewise/flapwise/torsional stiffness and axial-stiffness curves of Figure 2-10 (only curve values are readable, so exact numbers would need chart reading). The five 'structural property center' claims are legend labels of Figure 2-11 with a vague shared attribute; they would be better stated as chordwise offsets of the pitch axis / mass / neutral / geometric / shear centers versus blade span.
